n: MIT RAISE How to Train Your Robot
t: A free 30-hour middle school curriculum on training robot companions with machine learning.
steps: Find the How to Train Your Robot curriculum on the MIT RAISE site.
Download the Educator Guide and Student Workbook.
Gather the low-cost robot named in the guide.
Connect the computer to the robot through the AI Blocks page.
Ask IT to check the web environment and any accounts.
